args.title: Apify config + 0600 credential needed; csv-preflight demand now weak, rss-reader is the next candidate
args.detail: Still missing: a valid enabled Apify configuration and a private Apify credential file with mode 0600. Update: products/research/csv-paid-demand-test.json found 12 competing CSV validators with at most 1 user in 30 days each (verdict DO_NOT_PURSUE). csv-preflight stays ready but parked; listing it would cost nothing extra but is unlikely to earn. products/research/next-idea-scan.json recommends an RSS/Atom feed reader Actor (PURSUE_IF: 2 incumbents with 39-51 users_30d, crowded market, price-based edge only). It is being built offline (mission RSS-ACTOR-BUILD). After access: private PUBLISH_ACTOR, a real run, then independent APPROVE of the exact digest before any public listing. Kill if fewer than 3 external users in 14 days.
args.expected_gain: First Apify pay-per-event listing (rss-reader, proposed USD 0.001 per item); revenue unverified and uncertain.

description: CSV-PAID-DEMAND-TEST completed: DO_NOT_PURSUE. The 12 direct CSV-validator competitors on Apify each have at most 1 user in 30 days and 2 users ever; paid-user share can't be observed. NEXT-IDEA-SCAN completed over 5 jobs. Screenshots, PDF/OCR and sitemaps are DO_NOT_PURSUE. Broken links and RSS are PURSUE_IF; RSS is recommended but crowded (14+ listings) and its only edge is price. Queued: an RSS Actor build mission, a real public feed fixture, and an honest update to the Apify access blocker. No revenue, users or publication.
